name: Elin Rhys
bio:
Elin's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally, sparked by a childhood fascination with the logistical challenges of large-scale events. After obtaining a degree in risk management, she honed her skills in corporate security before transitioning to the high-octane world of racing. Her sharp analytical mind and meticulous approach quickly made her a sought-after asset. 

At RFK Racing, Elin's primary focus is ensuring the safety and security of the team's assets, personnel, and intellectual property. She thrives on the fast-paced environment, implementing cutting-edge security protocols and fostering a culture of vigilance. Her ability to anticipate potential threats and develop proactive solutions sets her apart, making her an invaluable member of the RFK Racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elin has a serious demeanor, framed by her dark hair and intelligent hazel eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down observations and potential security risks.
Has an uncanny ability to spot counterfeit team merchandise from a distance.
Insists on conducting regular security drills, much to the initial chagrin of some team members.
